title: Don't Buy An Extended Warranty On An Appliance Until You Have Watched This
summary: An appliance reviewer lists ten contract details to check before extending an appliance's manufacturer warranty.

assertions.quote: some Brands will offer a threee standard warranty and other brands will go for a 5year

verdicts.note: Standard term for most major appliance brands at retail.

assertions.quote: does the policy cover accidental damage this is something that a standard manufacturer's warranty definitely won't cover

verdicts.note: Accidental damage is a routine exclusion from manufacturer warranties and a common add-on feature of extended plans.

assertions.quote: some policies as soon as you made a claim then the warranty policy is null and void

verdicts.note: Claim limits and payout caps are a documented fine-print feature in many extended warranty and service contracts.

assertions.quote: if that retailer say goes bust then you've lost any of the warranty on that product
is there a certain time frame that you have to wait until you can claim on the warranty policy

verdicts.note: Waiting periods before a new policy's coverage activates are a common contract feature meant to deter immediate claims.

assertions.quote: does the extended warranty policy that you're about to buy offer new for old

verdicts.note: Replacement-in-lieu-of-repair clauses exist in some plans, though not universally.
